authority: AGENT dispositions independently reviewed PASS in supporting/final-results-review.md; formal goal/item closure remains owner-held

findings.finding: The common source is supplied; plasma sustainment and global manufactured fit are not qualified.
findings.disposition: Declared seam: retain this condition at every whole-plant conclusion; no reactor qualification claim.

findings.finding: The selected primary and divertor offers cannot support the 3000 MW source condition.
findings.disposition: Declared seam: preserve failed cases and exclude this source from paired preference; no automatic hardware resizing.

findings.finding: Transferred nuclear heating is not a validated bound for the changed magnet/blanket geometry.
findings.disposition: Declared seam: vary demand at fixed cryoplant and retain the native capacity bracket; updated transport remains future research.

findings.finding: Generated descriptive CAS codes disagree with the accepted account categories; executable membership is correct.
findings.disposition: Declared seam: use the explicit reviewed mapping for this report; correct metadata before using generic CAS rollups.

findings.finding: The finite equipment window has uncaught edges and the technologies have different modeled operating freedoms.
findings.disposition: Declared seam: report finite-catalog minima and conditional scenarios; no equal global technology optimization claim.

findings.finding: The first oracle scan overlapped in-place regeneration and read temporarily absent input defaults.
findings.disposition: Corrected execution: retain invalid scan, serialize regeneration and scanning, and use the zero-refusal replacement scan.

findings.finding: The static validator reports inherited literal/alias diagnostics on the compiled assembly.
findings.disposition: Declared seam: retain raw exit1 and reviewed identity-level dispositions with zero unresolved diagnostics; do not call static validation green.

findings.finding: Equipment price and common reactor account stresses are explicit assumptions rather than established market uncertainty intervals.
findings.disposition: Declared seam: report conditional preference and native thresholds; do not present engineered endpoints as credible confidence bounds.

findings.finding: Independent high-precision adjudication found that the cooler oracle stopped too early at one near-pinch failed offer.
findings.disposition: Model fix: independently reviewed tighter Brent convergence; original failure retained, controls and replacement study require unchanged acceptance tolerances.

findings.finding: The original ±1e-5 W/m³ cryogenic bracket produced nearly cancelled margins that failed relative verification.
findings.disposition: Declared seam: preserve the failed first record; use the separately reviewed ±0.01 W/m³ diagnostic resolution and retain both sides of the native capacity failure.
